fixed_resources.execution_topology: Four independent one-GPU apps and four local controllers; no shared GPU pool.

clock_contract.local_start: Record the absolute block start and consume its single START permit before image/app build or any potentially billable operation.
clock_contract.hard_deadline: local_start + hard_seconds. Includes build/startup, every remote attempt, all GPU/CPU work, in-process ACK waits, streamed transfers and verified app stop. This is an enforced operational deadline, not proof a provider can never bill beyond it.
clock_contract.worker_deadline: local_start + hard_seconds -30, passed unchanged to every remote invocation; no reset after reconnect/preemption.
clock_contract.provider_timeout: The function timeout is provider_seconds, always under24h. Parent absolute deadline takes precedence if startup, setup or replacement starts late.
clock_contract.run_settings: Set fixed RunSettings.max_seconds to run_settings_max_seconds. Its existing elapsed clock includes streaming/ACK barriers and is never paused. This grants ceil(backend)+3154 seconds of run time.
clock_contract.overhead_breakdown: 3904/block =120 build/startup +3154 admitted in-process ACK/slippage +600 terminal transfer +30 verified shutdown. Late setup can consume transfer grace; absolute/provider deadlines override and never extend to preserve nominal grace.
clock_contract.streaming: Local durable stream only, maximum8MiB chunks, bounded ACK waits within remaining absolute deadline. ACK only after checksum and local durable write; no persistent volume and no official-test arrays uploaded.
clock_contract.preemption_or_retry: An automatic or unverified extra attempt cannot reset deadlines or obtain another START permit. Stop/retain incomplete evidence if an attempt cannot continue under the approved exact-once contract; no refill or restarted scientific work without a reviewed remaining-budget path.
clock_contract.cleanup: Each controller stops its app at its unchanged worker deadline and verifies zero running containers by its hard deadline. Any cohort failure triggers root to stop all other apps immediately. Unknown shutdown exposure remains charged; do not launch replacements or extra blocks.

suite_stop_contract.launch_gate: Root atomically reserves all four unchanged block exposure caps in one local cumulative ledger before launching any app. Each block consumes its own single START permit; at most one active container per app and at most four apps. Concurrent starts cannot double-spend the same reserve.
suite_stop_contract.accounting: Sum all four charged exposure intervals, including overlaps, from each pre-build local_start until its app is verified stopped. Include every replacement/unknown attempt, ACK wait and uncertain shutdown. Charge the frozen upper rate per app unless actual provider metering is higher; do not use parallel elapsed walltime as total billable time.
suite_stop_contract.contingency: The unallocated scientific headroom is reserved for uncertain shutdown/replacement/stream overhead; it is not an automatic extension of any block timer or permission to draw new candidates.
suite_stop_contract.failure: Any block/time/budget/transfer/attempt-integrity failure triggers root to stop all remaining apps, preserves incomplete evidence and prevents local heldout evaluation. All four fixed blocks must complete and seal before local evaluation.
suite_stop_contract.global_watchdog: Monitor projected accrued exposure plus remaining committed block exposure against42USD science and the cumulative50USD ledger. Enforce each unchanged block deadline independently; never reset a deadline on a new invocation. Stop all apps immediately if aggregate price/rate/exposure threatens the remaining cap.

review_status: Pending independent concurrency/transfer arithmetic and executor integration review; root owns all launches and four controllers.

outbound_transfer_contract.raw_counter: max_return_bytes counts accepted raw file bytes plus serialized JSON control/manifest bytes; all outgoing frames consume the same per-block counter.
outbound_transfer_contract.wire_counter: Reserve and meter twice the raw counter as a conservative wire-equivalent estimate for SDK/protobuf/blob framing and control traffic. Exact provider-internal network retries are not observable; provider billing remains authoritative.
outbound_transfer_contract.cap_derivation: Two measured calibration-size checkpoints per candidate (probe and possible finalist), plus1MiB each for serialization variation; int64 probe and100-epoch final shuffle files; explicit history/source/metadata/log/control allowances; round each raw cap up to64MiB. No architecture/ranking/outcome extrapolation.
outbound_transfer_contract.transfer_once: Stream each immutable phase file/checkpoint exactly once. Send append-only root-log deltas and one final flush of untransferred bytes. No checkpoint duplicate, replay, refetch or automatic resend after lost/corrupt stream.
outbound_transfer_contract.admission: Before sending each file/frame, reject any declared or cumulative size exceeding the block allowance; count actual bytes too. Cap raw chunks at8MiB. Lost/corrupt/oversize stream fails the whole cohort rather than obtaining more egress allocation.
outbound_transfer_contract.artifact_scope: Only declared phase checkpoints, permutations, histories, source/config/hash evidence and bounded logs. Training arrays and local heldout arrays are excluded from returned files.
outbound_transfer_contract.limitations: Measured checkpoint size plus headroom is a prospective planning allowance, not proof every future artifact fits. An exceeded cap stops the cohort; it cannot silently raise the budget.
